blurb: Guests board The Grand Lady riverboat at Steamboat Park in Jenison, Michigan, for cruises on the Grand River. The boat features two decks, restrooms, and a bar, with seating open and community tables on the upper deck for live music cruises. Passengers see river scenes, wildlife, and local landmarks along the cruise.
